scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix admin
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,admin -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix admin"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix admin
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
